purpose: Authoritative inventory of Terraform-managed AirlineDemo resources, lifecycle ownership, data and network boundaries, cost allocation, outputs, and identity assignment ownership.

sourceOfTruth.stateBackendLifecycle: Bootstrap is independently approved and remains outside the disposable deployment root and its teardown scope.

disposableDemo.teardown: Only this disposable demo boundary may be destroyed by the approved teardown after data and recording retention decisions; it never includes the protected remote-state backend.

externallyOwnedRemoteState.teardown: Must not be destroyed, imported, or changed by disposable demo teardown; state bootstrap and cleanup remain an independently approved platform-owner operation outside the deployment root.

privateEvidence.boundary: Private, versioned case evidence is a separate data boundary from the Container Apps application runtime and its registry.
privateEvidence.runtimePermission: The Container App runtime receives only Storage Blob Data Reader on this evidence storage account; it receives no state-backend or host-storage permission.

applicationRuntime.boundary: The Container App hosts application code only; the Container Apps environment and registry are disposable runtime infrastructure, not evidence storage.
applicationRuntime.evidenceAccess: Case-scoped evidence access is through the private evidence boundary, not application-host storage or the remote-state backend.

costTagPolicy.directlyTaggedResources: Resources whose Terraform provider schema accepts tags receive the common or bootstrap tag set.

modules.dataBoundary: Private, versioned synthetic evidence blobs only; no workflow-state or runtime-host storage.
modules.networkExposure: Private storage account; public network access disabled and storage firewall defaults to Deny.

modules.dataBoundary: Synthetic application telemetry and diagnostic logs; not evidence content or workflow business state.
modules.networkExposure: Azure Monitor managed service endpoints; no application ingress or storage data-plane endpoint is created by this module.

modules.dataBoundary: Application runtime only. The runtime can read case-scoped evidence and call the explicitly assigned AI services; no runtime-host storage is provisioned.
modules.networkExposure: Container App has external ingress restricted to supplied CIDR ranges. Registry uses its Azure data plane with admin credentials disabled. Role assignments and the managed identity have no network endpoint.

modules.dataBoundary: Authoritative workflow, business, and audit state for synthetic demo cases; schema migration is a separate identity boundary.
modules.networkExposure: Public Azure SQL endpoint with the provider's Azure-services firewall rule; authentication is Entra-only and the endpoint remains firewall-restricted.

modules.dataBoundary: Bounded document extraction data plane for case-scoped synthetic evidence.
modules.networkExposure: Public service endpoint with explicit IP network ACLs and default action Deny; local authentication is disabled.

modules.dataBoundary: Governed Azure OpenAI extraction/classification data plane for bounded case-scoped processing; model output cannot choose policy or permissions.
modules.networkExposure: Public service endpoint with explicit IP network ACLs and default action Deny; Azure Services bypass is provider-configured and local authentication is disabled.

modules.dataBoundary: Sensitive Terraform state and blob lease metadata only; no application evidence or workflow data.
modules.networkExposure: State storage has a private blob container and a Deny-by-default firewall limited to approved operator CIDRs. Entra authentication is required and shared keys are disabled.

resources.dataBoundary: Azure resource-group control-plane boundary for disposable demo resources.
resources.networkExposure: No data-plane endpoint.

resources.dataBoundary: Private, versioned synthetic evidence blobs; separate from runtime-host storage.
resources.networkExposure: Private; public network access disabled, shared access keys disabled, firewall default Deny.

resources.dataBoundary: Lifecycle policy for evidence blob versions only.
resources.networkExposure: No data-plane endpoint; applies to the private evidence account.

resources.dataBoundary: Synthetic application telemetry and diagnostic logs.
resources.networkExposure: Azure Monitor managed endpoint; no public application ingress provisioned.

resources.dataBoundary: Synthetic application telemetry correlated to the Log Analytics workspace.
resources.networkExposure: Azure Monitor managed endpoint; no application ingress provisioned.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps application image artifacts and registry metadata only; no admin credentials or case evidence.
resources.networkExposure: Azure Container Registry data plane with admin authentication is disabled; registry exposure is independent of the Container App's external ingress and no registry credential is an output.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps environment metadata and hosting control plane only; no case evidence, workflow state, or registry credentials.
resources.networkExposure: Managed hosting environment for the externally restricted Container App; it has no separate application endpoint or public data boundary.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps application runtime only; evidence access is through the separate private evidence account and no application-host storage is provisioned.
resources.networkExposure: External ingress is enabled on the configured port and restricted by the supplied CIDR allow-list; scale-to-zero and one maximum replica are configured.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps migration identity metadata only; used for versioned SQL migrations and not application runtime, evidence access, or deployment credentials.
resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint; SQL scope is supplied through the separately approved migration path.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps runtime permission metadata only; grants read access to private evidence blobs.
resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint; exact resource scope is the private evidence storage account.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps runtime permission metadata only; grants the bounded Document Intelligence use role.
resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint; exact resource scope is the Document Intelligence account.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps runtime permission metadata only; grants the bounded Azure OpenAI use role.
resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint; exact resource scope is the Azure OpenAI account.

resources.dataBoundary: Azure SQL control plane and Entra-only connection boundary for synthetic workflow state.
resources.networkExposure: Public endpoint with Azure-services firewall rule; no SQL password is provisioned.

resources.dataBoundary: Authoritative workflow, business, and audit state for synthetic demo cases.
resources.networkExposure: Reachable only through the SQL server's firewall and Entra authentication boundary.

resources.dataBoundary: Firewall configuration metadata only.
resources.networkExposure: Allows Azure services through the SQL public endpoint; this is not a private endpoint.

resources.dataBoundary: Bounded synthetic document extraction service.
resources.networkExposure: Public endpoint with IP ACL default Deny; local authentication disabled.

resources.dataBoundary: Governed synthetic extraction/classification model account.
resources.networkExposure: Public endpoint with IP ACL default Deny and Azure Services bypass; local authentication disabled.

resources.dataBoundary: One explicitly selected, governed Azure OpenAI model deployment.
resources.networkExposure: Uses the parent Azure OpenAI account endpoint and its network ACL; no independent endpoint.

resources.dataBoundary: Externally owned control-plane boundary for retained protected Terraform state.
resources.networkExposure: No application data-plane endpoint; this resource belongs to state bootstrap, not the disposable workload.

resources.dataBoundary: Externally owned sensitive Terraform state blobs and versions only; no disposable demo data is stored here.
resources.networkExposure: The service public-network flag remains enabled, but its firewall defaults to Deny and permits only approved operator CIDRs; shared keys are disabled.

resources.dataBoundary: Externally owned private Terraform state container; state is sensitive and never a disposable workload output.
resources.networkExposure: Private blob container; access requires Entra authorization, the state account firewall, and the separately approved state scope.

resources.dataBoundary: Externally owned permission metadata only; container-scoped state read/write and lease access.
resources.networkExposure: No application network endpoint; exact scope is the protected state blob container.

nonSecretOutputPolicy.published: Resource IDs, names, public service endpoints, approved deployment names, and identity principal/client IDs needed by separately owned deployment or migration steps.
nonSecretOutputPolicy.runtimeHostStorageAccess: Not provisioned by this root. Evidence access is private and separate: the Container App receives only Storage Blob Data Reader on the evidence storage account, and no runtime-host storage account or host-storage role is created.

identityInventory.name: deployment
identityInventory.lifecycle: Externally supplied Entra deployment principal; its workload authorization is tenant/subscription-approved and separate from workload identities.
identityInventory.minimumScope: Only the Protected state container plus the approved workload infrastructure scope required to create or update this deployment.

assignments.approval: Platform-owner approval; deployment principal object ID is supplied privately.

assignments.role: Minimum resource-management permissions for this Terraform root
assignments.implementation: Externally supplied deployment authorization; not a workload role assignment
assignments.approval: Tenant/subscription administrator approval required; never reused by runtime or migration.

identityInventory.name: runtime
identityInventory.lifecycle: System-assigned identity created with the Container App and removed with it; it is never an infrastructure deployment credential.
identityInventory.minimumScope: Exactly three resource-scoped data-plane roles and no subscription-wide role: evidence account reader, Document Intelligence user, and Azure OpenAI user.

assignments.approval: Deployment principal must be authorized to create the role assignment; no tenant-wide runtime grant.
Deployment principal must be authorized to create the role assignment; no tenant-wide runtime grant.
Deployment principal must be authorized to create the role assignment; no tenant-wide runtime grant.

identityInventory.name: migration
identityInventory.lifecycle: Terraform-managed user-assigned identity retained with the disposable workload until approved teardown; it is distinct from runtime and deployment identities.
identityInventory.minimumScope: Only the workload SQL database, for versioned schema migration through the separately supplied and tenant-approved SQL Entra administrator path.

assignments.implementation: deployment/sql-migration-procedure.md and the SQL Entra administrator path
assignments.approval: Tenant-level Entra/SQL administrator approval required; not granted by the workload root and not a deployment credential.

identityInventory.name: terraform-state
identityInventory.lifecycle: Independent protected-state access path; externally owned state resources outlive disposable demo resources.
identityInventory.minimumScope: Only the private Terraform state blob container, using Entra-authenticated backend access and native blob lease locking; never application data.

assignments.approval: Protected-state/platform-owner approval; bootstrap is outside the deployment root.

roleAssignmentImplementation.protectedStateWork: terraform/bootstrap/main.tf supplies the container-scoped Storage Blob Data Contributor assignment for the externally supplied deployment principal.
roleAssignmentImplementation.identityOperatingModelWork: terraform/modules/container-apps/main.tf supplies the three exact resource-scoped runtime assignments and distinct runtime/migration identities.
roleAssignmentImplementation.migrationPermission: The SQL migration assignment is intentionally supplied through the separately owned SQL Entra administrator path documented in deployment/sql-migration-procedure.md; this root does not grant it.
